To enter that chamber, according to this scroll, you will need the Nightsister Key of Exile.|[[Rohak]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TNH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Nightsister Headdress|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
The '''Chamber of Banishment''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cavernous]] chamber located in the deepest part of the [[Rancor Cave]] near the [[Nightsister Stronghold]] operated by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Coven/Legends|clan]] of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomir Witches]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==History==
{{Quote|The energy surging through the headdress is a signal to her followers. It means that Axkva Min has discovered a way to free herself from her banishment, and she is contacting her followers so that they will assist in her escape. Axkva Min is a dangerous being that will threaten the entire planet...possibly even the entire galaxy. We must help stop her.|Rohak, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TNH" />}}
Sometime during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the Nightsister [[Axkva Min]] was imprisoned in the chamber by fellow Nightsisters due to her apt to drain the life from her pupils in order to increase her own power.<ref name="SWG:TNH" /><ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref> There, Min and her most loyal followers were trapped inside large [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]]. The cave was guarded by Nightsisters and required the [[Key of Exile]] to be opened.<ref name="SWG:AM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Axkva Min discovered a way to free herself from her banishment and contacted her followers to assist her escape. The situation was soon discovered by [[Rohak]], the [[Aurilia]] town elder, and a group of spacers. The spacers therefore explored Dathomir to gather four shards that they fused together to form the Key of Exile.<ref name="SWG:TNH" /> The group of spacers later enter the Chamber of Banishment where they defeated Min's followers: [[Nandina]] and [[Gorvo]], [[Lelli Hi]], [[Kimaru]] and [[Suin Chalo]]. They eventually killed Axkva Min herself during an epic fight.<ref name="SWG:AM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chamber of Banishment first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Chamber of Banishment was the site of the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]] that was introduced to the game in the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update, released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
